title: Abashitsi badasanzwe bo mu gisagara gikikujwe n'inkuta
intro: Hari umugwi washitse ku marembo y’igisagara abantu baco batigeze bamenya ukuri. Bazana ubutumwa, ariko abahatuye barahinduka abansi, batera ubwoba ko bazogira ubukazi. Yamara, ijwi rimwe ryaradutse rivuye ahantu umuntu atari yiteze kugira ngo arwanire abo banyamahanga, ivyo bikaba vyatumye ibintu bihinduka bitangaje.
clues: Twinjiye mu gisagara abantu baco bari barengewe n’ukutemera.
Baraturaba bacika intege, bati: 'Muri ibiremwa bisanzwe nkatwe.'
Umuntu umwe yarirutse avuye ku mpera y’igisagara ya kure cane kugira ngo yemeze ukuri kwacu.
Yabwiye abantu biwe ati: 'Kubera iki ntasenga Uwandemye?'
Ukwihakana kw’igisagara kwarangiye n’igisasu kimwe, maze aho bari bahora batwengera mw’ijigo haba uguceceka.

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
